ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of the Antarctic region. Among the labels of our country's Antarctic scientific research stations, Great Wall Station can be seen located near the Antarctic Peninsula and close to the edge of the continent; Zhongshan Station is also near the edge of the Antarctic continent; Kunlun Station is marked in the interior of the Antarctic continent, in a position closer to the inland high-latitude region. Then reason: astronomical observation is suitable for a high-altitude inland ice-sheet environment with dry air, high transparency, little light pollution, and little influence from the ocean. Kunlun Station is located on the high interior of Antarctica, and its conditions are more suitable for astronomical observation than coastal Great Wall Station, Zhongshan Station, and others, so the answer is Kunlun Station.
